verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a cloud sandbox service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents choosing where sandbox data or containers are located. Mounting external S3-compatible buckets (R2, S3, GCS) is a developer building block, not a residency control the product itself provides, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
